name: Bergman & Beving AB (publ)
summary: Bergman & Beving AB (publ) provides solutions for the manufacturing and construction sectors in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Benelux, the Baltics, Denmark, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Core Solutions, Safety Technology, Machinery & Equipment, and PPE & Utilities. It offers fasteners, metal roofs, heat exchangers, and inspection hatches, as well as wooden wedges, laminate panels, temporary protective coatings for window surfaces, and wall and roof hatches.
